note: Early band (spec Level Band Guidelines, amended 2026-10-06): regular boards of 224–288 cells (14×16 up to 16×18; they were 12×12–12×13), 3–4 variants with all four families by L20, 10–22 pods, work 150–275. Mechanics apply only from their roadmap level. Since 2026-10-07 (the owner) every board size from 14×16 to 22×28 comes about evenly from L11: a board over 288 cells is a big board in the icons look, its pods, work and durations grow with its cells (these upper bounds are a 22×28 board's, pods at most 56), and its class thresholds grow toward the band's big ones.
